description: Exact tracked paths sweep-lane-residue.mjs repo mode may report without failing. Every row names one file, never a folder or glob, and says why each of its matches is not live residue of the skill advisor's retired semantic lane. A row whose file stops matching is listed as unused, never as an error. The trigger index and its three sidecar fixtures take no row: repo mode judges each of their lane entries by the path it points at.
